name: Azure Stream Analytics
sku: Azure Stream Analytics, cloud and IoT Edge.

transform.stream-processing.note: A fully managed stream processing engine. Jobs read from Event Hubs, IoT Hub or Blob and Data Lake storage, and use a SQL query language with temporal constraints, plus pattern matching, geospatial and anomaly detection functions. It guarantees exactly-once processing with at-least-once delivery.

presentation.tagline: SQL-based stream processing over event data, with a no-code editor.
